operations.name: status
operations.description: Read current state and passive resource diagnostics without starting app-server. core.resources exposes state, nofile {soft, hard, state, source, observedAt, error}, and startup {targetSoft:8192, original, actual, attemptedSoft, platformCeiling, state, reasons, observedAt}. core.appServer adds pid, startedAt (spawn time), communication state and resources {state, nofile, fd:{count,sampledAt,attemptedAt,state,error}, usageRatio, warningRatio:0.9}. Limit values are numbers, unlimited, or null; sources: self-measured, inherited-at-spawn, child-measured, unavailable. Linux child measurement failure falls back to inheritance with measurementError. Unknown fd counts are null; Windows is not_applicable. diagnostics.checks.resources reuses these snapshots; findings: CORE_NOFILE_DEGRADED, APP_SERVER_NOFILE_DEGRADED, APP_SERVER_FD_PRESSURE. ready describes communication only. Resource states: ok, degraded, pressure, unknown, not_applicable. Sampling is on status reads, without a background monitor. See cli guide Resource diagnostics.

operations.name: runtime.inspect
operations.description: Read content-free process CPU/memory, bounded work counters, cache occupancy and Desktop IPC retention. Does not start upstream processes or load task histories. Counters reset on Core restart. CPU percent is 100 * delta process.cpuTotalMs / delta elapsedMs between samples of the same instance. Wall durations include waits and overlap; they are not CPU attribution. Cache sourceBytes/wireBytes are serialized sizes, not heap measurements. See cli guide Runtime diagnostics.

operations.name: app.replace

path.description: Absolute candidate .app path; must differ from the running installation.

check.description: Validate only; do not stage, launch a worker, or stop ARC.

immediate.description: Replace after receipt acknowledgment without task-idle checks or countdown. May interrupt ARC-owned work. Package, owner, shutdown and rollback checks still apply.

operations.description: macOS only. Validate and stage a same-identity package, then bootstrap a detached launchd worker. Returns a durable replacement receipt before shutdown. CLI and local management MCP acknowledge after flushing output; raw HTTP clients MUST call app.replace.ack after receiving it. End the dispatching turn immediately after receipt. Without immediate:true, the helper waits up to five minutes for unsafe or unobservable work while eligible ARC-owned Codex turns are recorded for native resume, then announces a ten-second restart countdown. Immediate mode skips both waits. Backups use <state>/app-replacements/backups/. Native notifications and status report phases and outcomes. The helper verifies installed Desktop and Core health and rolls back on failure. Read app.replace.status after reconnecting. Optional continuation {threadId,prompt,model?,turn?,notify?} is persisted before shutdown and submitted once through codex_send(sendMode:queue) after verified success. Its requestId and dispatch receipt remain in replacement status; reconcile that original ID after an uncertain submission. Failed or rolled-back replacements do not send it. interruptedTurns records all ARC-owned Codex turns before shutdown, with stable continuation IDs, original dispatch attribution and notification binding. Eligible entries resume through codex_resume(threadId,turnId) after verified health, preserving the existing interrupted-continuation scope; pending interactions and uncertain writes require attention. Read app.replace.snapshot for live eligibility. Each automatic entry has one resume requestId and exposes resumeReceipt in status; an explicit continuation replaces automatic resume for its thread and retains existing queue rules.

operations.name: app.replace.snapshot
operations.description: Read the live ARC-owned Codex turns eligible for replacement continuation, original dispatch and notification binding, pending interactions and write blockers. Does not stop or resume work. Replacement persists a fresh snapshot immediately before shutdown.

operations.name: app.replace.status
operations.description: Read the latest durable replacement receipt, phase, statusPath, logPath, backup and error. Works offline through CLI/local management MCP.

operations.name: app.replace.ack
operations.description: Acknowledge receipt of app.replace before the worker may stop ARC. Raw HTTP clients send the returned id after reading the response. CLI and local management MCP do this automatically after output flush. Without acknowledgment the worker cancels after 60 seconds.

operations.name: operations.submit
operations.description: Submit an asynchronous operation with a stable requestId; same ID never replays. Read affected resources after completion. Outputs are not retained; call secret-returning operations synchronously.

operations.name: agents.activity
operations.description: Active sessions with normalized phases, pending interactions and timeline availability; retains activeAgents.

operations.name: agents.dispatch_catalog
operations.description: Read Agent-native model and option labels for recorded dispatch specs. Codex reads model/list. Other Agents reuse live or persisted session catalogs, or native catalog snapshots. This read never creates or resumes a task or changes dispatch configuration. taskId is optional and applies only to non-Codex ARC tasks.

operations.name: agents.conversations
operations.description: Read a metadata-only conversation page. Codex keeps native unarchived threads in descending creation order. Claude Code and Pi v3 merge read-only native sessions with ARC tasks (scope:native-and-arc-tasks); other Agents expose ARC tasks. Non-Codex rows sort by updatedAt descending, then id ascending. ARC task identity wins nativeSessionId matches. Native rows use source:native, bounded head/tail metadata and a 30-second on-demand cache; metadataPartial marks incomplete samples and messageCount is null when unavailable. Claude child/sidechain sessions are excluded. limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 50. Reuse nextCursor unchanged. Open the returned id with agents.conversations.timeline. Listing never builds timelines or resumes sessions; transcript paths remain private.

operations.name: agents.conversations.timeline
operations.description: Read the selected conversation timeline without resuming it. Use the id returned by agents.conversations. Unknown Codex histories and indexed Claude Code/Pi native sessions remain read-only without joining ARC live ownership. Native Claude history uses the existing bounded transcript timeline; Pi v3 follows the latest leaf ancestry. Other Agents must own the ARC task ID. after is the last update cursor; readOnly responses are full snapshots with coverage and no transcript path.

operations.name: agents.resources
operations.description: Read a bounded image or reveal a file in the host file manager. Resolve paths only inside the selected task's project or its dedicated thread visualization directory, including symlink checks. Read native metadata without resuming the Agent. Images return a data URL; unavailable assets report an error. No caller-supplied project root or arbitrary file access.

operations.name: tasks.control
operations.description: Run an existing task operation from the authenticated local UI. Operation owners validate arguments and stable receipt IDs; no remote MCP schema changes.

operations.name: tasks.reviews
operations.description: Read persisted review verdicts for a task.

operations.name: tasks.reviews.undo
operations.description: Undo only the matching local ARC pass review. A changed verdict or reviewer rejects the undo; external reviews are preserved.

operations.name: agents.respond
operations.description: Respond to a pending activity interaction through its supplied op and args. A stable requestId replays the existing response receipt; unconfirmed outcomes must be read back, never resent under a new ID.

operations.name: agents.timeline
operations.description: Normalized entries for an activity session ID. after is the last returned update cursor; merge entries by id. External sessions return readOnly full snapshots without after. Coverage reports bounded history.

operations.name: preferences.import

operations.name: ingress.oauth.client.remove
operations.description: Remove a registered OAuth client and revoke its grants and pending requests.

operations.name: setup.next
operations.description: Read the current setup step; goal previews a sequence without persisting it.

operations.name: setup.apply
operations.description: Submit a decision or execute a setup action. Reuses existing ingresses. Secret steps accept source: clipboard; Core saves and clears it, returning saved flags only.

operations.name: setup.wait
operations.description: Wait for the current setup step to change; timeout is a normal result.

operations.name: setup.dispatch
operations.description: Choose a setup goal, install arc-setup for Codex and create or reuse its local setup task. Uses the default Codex model and reasoning settings.

operations.name: relay.list
operations.description: List locally configured relays and bundled ARC/Worker version. No invitation or private key is returned.

operations.name: relay.progress
operations.description: Read last relay job: jobId, phase (idle/login/deploying/connecting/ready/failed), reason, loginUrl, relayId, ingressId, result; accounts is present if account selection is required. loginUrl is transient and must not be logged.

operations.name: relay.create
operations.description: Start creation via managed Wrangler browser OAuth, deploy bundled Worker with management public key secret, register this instance with the computer device name and connect. Returns job snapshot; read relay.progress. Installs an isolated Node.js/Wrangler deployment tool when needed; ordinary relay traffic stays native.

operations.name: relay.redeploy
operations.description: Owner only: redeploy bundled ARC version, preserving Worker name, identities, members and shared token. Also resumes a partially completed creation.

operations.name: relay.join
operations.description: Join a shared relay using this computer's device name and connect. The optional name labels the local connection. The invitation token is consumed for registration and not stored on member machines. Returns a progress job.

operations.name: relay.connect
operations.description: Reconnect an already registered local instance. Returns a progress job.

operations.name: relay.cancel
operations.description: Cancel the running job and terminate its deployment process tree. Completed remote effects are retained and reported through relay.list; cancellation is not a rollback.

operations.name: relay.me
operations.description: Read only this instance: id, publicKey, name, joinedAt, lastOnline, online.

operations.name: relay.leave
operations.description: Remove this instance from the relay, stop/delete its local ingress. Owners retain local relay management authority.

operations.name: relay.instances
operations.description: Owner signature only: list relay instances, display names, join times, last online, online status, and isSelf (matched locally by instance ID).

operations.name: relay.remove
operations.description: Owner signature only: revoke an instance address and active connection immediately. A revoked identity cannot rejoin with a shared token.

operations.name: relay.share
operations.description: Owner only: return shared link encoding relay origin and invitation token in the URL fragment. Do not log the result.

operations.name: relay.reset-token
operations.description: Owner signature only: rotate shared invitation token and return a new shared link; existing members remain registered.

operations.name: relay.delete
operations.description: Owner signature only: tombstone the relay, disconnect all instances, then delete the Worker with Wrangler. Returns a progress job. Failed physical deletion can be retried.

operations.name: local-access.status
operations.description: Read local Claude client availability and matching configuration.

operations.name: local-access.install
operations.description: Add a local control source using Claude Code CLI or Claude Desktop configuration; never replaces another server.

operations.name: app.snapshot
operations.description: Read the live UI model. modelOnly:true returns model inline without files or screenshots. Otherwise export view-model.json and macOS snapshot.png; other desktops report png.code=NOT_SUPPORTED. taskPanel reads or navigates one task detail. taskBubble reads or marks one completed homepage bubble read; model.taskBubbles exposes persisted agent/task read acknowledgements (30 days, newest 1000) and renderer retention. out defaults to state/acceptance/<unique id>; width/height are logical pixels; panel.id is required for agent/source. model.env reports effective instance environment values with source:system|override, active and expiresAt; width fields include observed value and requested override. Use control app_env to set or clear overrides without changing host settings.

operations.name: source.list
operations.description: List external control sources, including disconnected, revoked and pending sources. Built-in Local CLI/panel authority is excluded. pendingSwitch contains ingressId, expiresAt (Unix seconds), and requestId once bound; expired expectations are omitted.

operations.name: source.update

minimalText.description: Opt in to minimal MCP text while retaining structuredContent. Omitted source settings default to false.

capabilityProfile.description: null restores Legacy. Built-in local authority accepts host/background-cli only; MCP sources accept none or unknown with push or poll. Changes discovery, never execution policy.

operations.description: Update source label, product, minimalText, or capabilityProfile through local management. Local Code requires built-in local CLI authority.

operations.name: source.disconnect
operations.description: Revoke external source access and retain history. Built-in Local CLI/panel authority returns LOCAL_SOURCE_PROTECTED.

operations.name: source.claim
operations.description: Approve a pending source. Ordinary consent accepts sourceId=new or an existing source of the same product on the same connection. Switch consent requires its switchSourceId. The anchor moves after token exchange.

operations.name: source.switch
operations.description: Expect the next OAuth request on ingressId to claim this source. Expires in 300 seconds; one expectation per source and target. Occupied non-OAuth targets are rejected. An empty non-OAuth target completes on an observed authenticated request.

operations.name: source.switch.cancel
operations.description: Cancel the pending switch and its bound authorization request. The original connection remains unchanged.

operations.name: accounts.list
operations.description: List provider accounts and the current login flow. Lists omit email and orgName; use accounts.get for details.

operations.name: accounts.get
operations.description: Read full account detail or a retained tombstone.

operations.name: accounts.whoami
operations.description: Read the calling source account from its authorization. Unresolved identities remain Unidentified; client names never establish identity.

operations.name: accounts.query
operations.description: List provider accounts, sources, Agent profiles, health, defaults, notification reachability and quota. id returns full detail; list omits email and orgName. Removed IDs return tombstones.

operations.name: accounts.update

default.description: With defaultFor, true (omitted) selects this account; false clears only this account for that Agent without choosing a replacement.

operations.description: Rename an account or set/clear its default profile for one Agent. default requires defaultFor.

operations.name: accounts.merge

quotaProviderId.description: An existing shared subscription provider ID; null selects native account quota.

operations.description: Merge explicitly user-confirmed account ownership. Retain old IDs and immutable task history; optionally link a shared subscription provider.

operations.name: accounts.add
operations.description: Start official login or detect native authentication. Returns loginId, state and loginUrl when available. Only sign-in requires the user. Read accounts to poll progress.

operations.name: accounts.login
operations.description: Submit the Claude authorization code or cancel an active login. Codex uses its browser callback and cannot accept a pasted code.

operations.name: accounts.reauth
operations.description: Restart native login for the selected account Agent profile.

operations.name: accounts.remove
operations.description: Remove an account from future dispatches and keep a tombstone. Let running work finish or cancel it explicitly. Existing source IDs and history are retained.

operations.name: accounts.browsers
operations.description: List installed browsers for login.

operations.name: accounts.send
operations.description: Send through the account Claude profile. HTTP success is delivery evidence only, not acknowledgement.

operations.name: accounts.test
operations.description: Send through the account Claude profile. HTTP success is delivery evidence only, not acknowledgement.

operations.name: accounts.route
operations.description: Bind a host notification target to an account.

operations.name: tasks.presence
operations.description: Report focused visible task detail presence. Refresh every two seconds; expires after six seconds.

operations.name: tasks.request-routing
operations.description: Read, pause, resume or hand off a pending request locally.

id.description: Pending responseId, or native id converted to a string.

operations.name: app.env
operations.description: Read expiring instance acceptance overrides. Set or clear through control app_env. Renderer-effective values are in app.snapshot model.env.

operations.name: coordination.observe
operations.description: Record a bounded local tooling lifecycle transition after registered repository and process/ref readback. Retry with the same transitionId and payload. No source report operation is exposed.

operations.name: coordination.observation
operations.description: Read back a locally persisted and projected tooling transition.

operations.name: src.conversations.query
operations.description: Read source-account container status and URL-only conversations with linked taskRefs. External callers see only their own account. Status is a URL heuristic, not proof of authentication or page contents. No cookies or page content are returned.

operations.name: src.conversations.profiles
operations.description: List Chrome Local State profile directory and display name only. macOS only; other platforms report unsupported.

operations.name: src.conversations.open
operations.description: Open and focus one native window for this source account. Omit conversationId and url to open https://claude.ai/new. Otherwise use a registered conversationId or a claude.ai Chat/Cowork URL without query or fragment. safariUserAgent persists an optional override (default false); close an existing window before changing it. Closing unloads the view. macOS 14+ only. No remote IPC or scripts.

operations.name: src.conversations.import

allowUnverified.description: Explicitly permit installation only when the imported organization is missing or unknown. Never overrides a known different-account mismatch.

operations.description: Start a background Chrome login import for this source account and return immediately with {accountId,status:"importing",next:{via:"query",op:"src_conversations",args:{accountId}}}. Concurrent imports for the same account return the in-flight status. Poll src_conversations: importing -> signed-in-pending when cookies are installed, not-imported when none are imported, or import-blocked with reason and a human-action hint. URL observation later yields signed-in or expired. Keychain waits up to 180 seconds; timeout/denial become keychain-timeout/keychain-denied. Enter the macOS login password in the Chrome Safe Storage prompt and choose Always Allow; never work around a denial. Native cookie writes must complete before navigation (30-second write timeout). No cookies, keys, decrypted bytes or page content are returned. No automatic retry after completion or failure. Before native installation, compare the imported lastActiveOrg in-process with confirmed SRC organization identities. A different known SRC yields import-mismatch with detectedAccountId and no installation. Unknown/missing identity yields import-unverified and no installation unless allowUnverified:true. No cookie or organization UUID is returned.

operations.name: src.conversations.bind
operations.description: Manually bind a dispatched task to a registered conversation on its origin account. conversationId:null unbinds. Cross-account binding is rejected. The next dispatch/send re-evaluates automatic binding. Task reads expose srcConversation including accountId, kind, id, url and basis.

operations.name: src.conversations.clear
operations.description: Clear only the selected account website login container. Close its window, wait for WKWebsiteDataStore removal, then remove the persisted store UUID mapping. Return {accountId,status:"not-imported"}. Keep conversations and task bindings. An in-flight import or pending cookie write must finish before clearing. Failed or unconfirmed removal retains the mapping and blocks reopening until clear is confirmed. This action destroys this account website data; it does not sign out Chrome. macOS 14+ only. Read back src_conversations before retrying.
